summary: Documentation-only feature adding a comprehensive how-to guide for local endpoint configuration (docs/how-to/local-endpoint-setup.md) with bidirectional cross-links from all three observability reference pages and the Configuration Reference. VitePress sidebar updated with the new guide and integration test reference page. The how-to guide covers prerequisites, credential resolution flow, step-by-step configuration for all three pipelines, common use cases (Prometheus, Loki, Elasticsearch), and troubleshooting. All YAML key names match the Go struct tags exactly. VitePress build succeeds with no errors. 7 files changed, 289 insertions.

issues_found.description: Link format inconsistent with established how-to guide pattern. The guide uses absolute paths (e.g., `/reference/observability/metrics-collection.md`) while all existing how-to guides (local-node-api.md, custom-hook-scripts.md) use relative paths (e.g., `../reference/observability/metrics-collection.md`). While VitePress resolves both, this breaks the project convention.
issues_found.fix: Replace all 9 absolute link paths with relative paths. In the Reference section and inline links: `/reference/observability/metrics-collection.md` → `../reference/observability/metrics-collection.md`, `/reference/observability/log-forwarding.md` → `../reference/observability/log-forwarding.md`, `/reference/observability/audit-forwarding.md` → `../reference/observability/audit-forwarding.md`, `/reference/core/configuration.md` → `../reference/core/configuration.md`, `/reference/core/key-storage.md` → `../reference/core/key-storage.md`, `/reference/development/local-endpoint-integration-tests.md` → `../reference/development/local-endpoint-integration-tests.md`.

issues_found.description: Frontmatter missing 'package' field. Other how-to guides include a `package` field (e.g., `package: internal/nodeapi` in local-node-api.md). Since this guide spans all three pipelines, this is a minor deviation.
issues_found.fix: Add `package: internal/api` to frontmatter (since LocalEndpointConfig is defined in internal/api/types.go and is the shared type across all pipelines).

suggested_improvements: D2-minor: The troubleshooting table rows at lines 231-239 are very wide. Consider splitting the longest entries (TLS handshake failures) into shorter cause/fix descriptions for better readability in narrow viewports.

DA3-minor: The how-to guide's use-case section correctly notes that adapters are needed for Prometheus/Loki/Elasticsearch, but could benefit from a brief mention that the payload schema documentation is in the reference pages (already linked but could be more prominent).
